Every body has its own set of ores. Most of them generate in large veins, so one find usually means many more nearby.

- §eMun§r - nickel, iron, lead, sulfur, fluorite, natural gas shale and brine deposits.
- §eMinmus§r - copper, niter, nether quartz, malachite, cinnabar and brine deposits.
- §eDuna§r - redstone, titanium, rare earth, beryllium, zinc, aluminium, tungsten, cinnabar, oil deposits and rich basalt.
- §eIke§r - uranium, plutonium, lanthanium, coltan, rich mineral deposits and brine deposits.
- §eMoho§r - australium, cinnabar, phosphorus, glowstone, rich mineral deposits, natural gas shale and rich basalt.
- §eDres§r - diamond, coltan, lanthanium, niobium and natural gas shale.
- §eEve§r - schrabidium, niobium, cobalt, natural gas deposits and §6iodine§r, which is found nowhere else.
- §eLaythe§r - aluminium, asbestos, tungsten and oil deposits.
- §eTekto§r - lithium, plutonium, beryllium, cinnabar and Tektonic crude.

Every body also has calcite, rare alexandrite, depth rock deposits near the bottom and its own bedrock ores. Watch for geysers: §6Volcanic Geysers§r on Moho, §6Discharge Geysers§r and electric volcanoes on Eve, and §6DCM Geysers§r on Tekto.
